steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Access ACU J16
steps.body: Remove top panel. Verify drum light connector J16 is secure at ACU and drum light harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove top panel. Verify drum light connector J16 is secure at ACU and drum light harness.

steps.title: J16 and harness OK
steps.body: Are J16 and drum light harness connections secure?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Are J16 and drum light harness connections secure?

branches.label: Harness issue
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace drum light harness, then retest.

steps.title: Unplug drum light
steps.body: Unplug drum light from harness at ACU side. Restore power for voltage check.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug drum light from harness at ACU side. Restore power for voltage check.

steps.title: Drum light driver J16 pins 1 & 3
steps.body: Measure VDC across J16 pins 1 and 3 with drum light disconnected. Expected 2.9–3.5 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure VDC across J16 pins 1 and 3 with drum light disconnected. Expected 2.9–3.5 VDC.

branches.label: 2.9–3.5 VDC
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drum LED — driver voltage present.

branches.label: Voltage not present
branches.oemOutcome: Replace ACU — drum light driver fault.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ACU when driver voltage missing.
